title: lavatera triloba var. minoricensis
intro: Lavatera triloba var. minoricensis, commonly known as the Minorcan Lavatera or Minorcan Tree Mallow, is a plant species in the mallow family that is native to the Balearic Islands, particularly Minorca. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, soothing skin irritations, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Lavatera triloba var. minoricensis include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic effects, making it useful for wound healing and skin care. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
